representation: seed0 frozen pretrained RoBERTa-base attention-mask mean pooling cache, L2 normalized
strict_split: existing P3B seed0 400 reference / 100 held-out probe; no probe labels in neighbor selection
target_distance: absolute original-scale V/A/D difference; macro mean of three
random_neighbor_control: exact expected mean over all 400 reference labels plus one fixed 8-of-400 without-replacement draw per probe
permutation_rule: permute only 400 reference label rows; keep embedding neighbors and 100 probe labels fixed
coverage: 8th nearest 3D normalized-label Euclidean radius; sparse threshold is 75th percentile of leave-one-out radii among 400 reference labels; apply to 100 held-out true labels only for evaluation
prediction_source: existing P3B 400-to-100 held-out predictions; spectral B1/B2 500 OOF only as separate selection-conditioned context
